title: Altered Alchemy
description: Changes the textures of potions so that they are distinguishable from each other
body:
Changes the textures of potions so that they are distinguishable from each other. 
There are textures for regular, splash, and lingering potions, as well as a texture for extended(Redstone) or strengthened(Glowstone) potions.

![A variety of potions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d257ec9e1111ca5ebb86ef3b4e164b3e0599518f.png)
